title: Events Announced
writeup: This evening's Sandhya Aarti brought the community together once again, as devotees gathered for prayers amidst the glow of diyas. During the gathering, we announced this year's festival events — Drawing Competition on Saturday (19th) at 4 PM, followed by Sports (Running, Rangoli, Lemon Spoon) on Sunday (20th) from 9 AM onwards. Bring your enthusiasm — and your own lemon spoon! 🥄
